**Risk flags:**
- Director 1 holds 75.67% of shares  

**Overview:** Jaya Unity Precision Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited manufacturing firm in Sarawak that specializes in precision machining of metal parts for electronics. Incorporated on 23 March 1988, the company has five directors and a share capital of RM 250,000, with the largest shareholder owning 75.67% of the equity. Financial statements show revenue growth from RM 11.9 million in 2022 to RM 16.1 million in 2024, with a shift from losses to a profit after tax of RM 745,161 in 2024. All three audited years received an unqualified opinion; no legal cases are recorded.
